proposal.summary: A vulnerability in libcap's pthread_create() may allow an attacker to cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust process memory.
proposal.cwe_quote: This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.

AV.quote: A vulnerability was found in the pthread_create() function in libcap.

A.quote: This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request from the reporter: full vulnerable libcap version range, a minimal proof-of-concept (steps or code) demonstrating how __real_pthread_create() is forced to return an error, and any exploitability details (remote vs local).

evidence_quotes.quote: A vulnerability was found in the pthread_create() function in libcap.
This issue may allow a malicious actor to use cause __real_pthread_create() to return an error, which can exhaust the process memory.
